name: TemperatureReadingEvent
doc: A body temperature measurement event published to the health-metrics.temperature Kafka topic.

fields.name: event_id
fields.doc: UUID generated by the ingestion service. Used as idempotency key.

fields.name: measured_at
fields.doc: ISO-8601 timestamp of the original device measurement.

fields.name: ingested_at
fields.doc: ISO-8601 timestamp when the ingestion service received the reading.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Temperature reading value in the unit specified by the 'unit' field.

type.name: TemperatureUnit
type.doc: Unit of the temperature reading as submitted by the device.

fields.name: device_source_id
fields.doc: Unique identifier of the submitting device or partner API.

fields.name: ingestion_source
fields.doc: Ingestion path: 'api' for single-record, 'batch' for batch submission.

fields.name: measurement_method
fields.doc: Optional measurement method (e.g., oral, axillary, tympanic). Null if not provided.
